name: Branislav Ivanović
bio:
Branislav's journey in motorsport began in the local karting scene of Belgrade, where he quickly distinguished himself not as a driver, but as a meticulous mechanic and strategist. His keen eye for detail and innate ability to diagnose mechanical issues led him to join a small Formula Ford team in the late 90s. Over the years, he steadily climbed the ranks, proving himself as a leader capable of extracting the maximum potential from his team, regardless of the available resources.

As team principal for Carlin Academy, Branislav fosters a culture of continuous improvement and data-driven decision-making. He's known for his hands-on approach, often found in the garage offering guidance and support. His pragmatic approach to problem-solving, coupled with his relentless pursuit of excellence, has made him a respected figure within the paddock. He believes in empowering his team members and providing them with the tools and knowledge they need to succeed.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: A man of medium build with a determined gaze and a practical demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on personally inspecting the tires before each race.
